individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A shows micrograph time-lapse images, not a plot; individual data points are not applicable.

The main graphs are scatter plots of raw normalized intensity measurements over time (individual time points shown as red/green markers) with a fitted model curve overlaid, so individual data are already displayed. The insets show averaged time-course traces with error bars (a line-plot style summary), which are exempt from requiring individual point overlays.

error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: not needed - Panel A contains only micrographs, no error bars.

FAIL - The insets show averaged early time-point responses with vertical error bars (variability indicators) on the euchromatin/heterochromatin data sets, but the caption does not state what these error bars represent (e.g., SD, SEM, or CI).
